kernel.contract: Arch22 CSA gathers from cmpKvGm via vector UB and writes a private kvMergeGm panel. MM1 reads its two 256-wide halves; MM2 loads the merged rows again with a different layout. Logical byte model for one full 512-BF16 row and one pass per phase. Actual templates, cache misses, head-group replication and hardware transactions are not inferred from source.

limits: Legacy 910C BF16 CSA compressed path only. All heads and dimensions, masks, current subset and order, sink, normalization, score ties and PV zeroing stay fixed. SWA-only and local-query-empty earn zero. Never use the 128-dimensional INT8 index key as the 512-dimensional BF16 compressed latent.

Nominal one 512-entry selected row per query, one pass per phase. Captured shapes and old durations bind sites. Valid counts, physical memory traffic, L1 layout compatibility, L2 hit rates and gather issue rates are not measured by these exports. Half-live and half-exposed estimates are sensitivity points, not uncertainty bounds. Negative values are slowdowns.

Direct two-read model: time saved per payload B = B*(3/panel_bw + 1/old_sparse_bw - 2/new_sparse_bw). Drop the second new read only if the same core can retain/reformat the necessary tile for PV after softmax. PMU engine-time ratios cannot identify interface byte counts. Any independent cost for descriptors, extra gather setup, synchronization, tiling and arithmetic must be charged.

Direct gather and private panel elimination occur within SMLA on all 38 compressed layers even with stock QLI. A cross-operator extra may fuse prepare into QLI to publish sorted positions or physical descriptors for a generation. The eight source layers feed 4 or 6 readers. Preserve stateful aliases and bank/page-table generation. The layer-20 candidate packet for later QLI and the eight SMLA-selected index lists are different; no previous four-layer QLI service gain is added.

The original host tiler selects 512 S2 rows. Its Cube KV buffer has 192 KiB across three slots; the separate Q/probability buffer has 256 KiB. A full 512-row BF16 KV panel costs 512 KiB. Retaining a whole segment for a second multiply cannot fit in that KV allocation. The 128/192-row sensitivity ignores competition with ongoing tiles and MM2 reformatting. A smaller tile can change softmax rounding and requires its own proof.

C8 keeps actual four eager waves, TP/DP arrival bounds and historical graph membership through deadline; native graph medians are a 128-window shape proxy. Ordinary estimates interpolate actual local prompt size with an earliest-versus-latest dense causal rank-position envelope, plus actual verification counts. The six ordinary requests do not establish performance for other workload distributions.

Short-fixture comparisons subtract the unfiltered arm from which candidate membership overhead was already removed; both arms keep one source call. Some short rows in a mixed batch do not make the entire batch short. Raw order observers, masked or exceptional scores, request-specific visibility and compressed lengths need explicit handling.
